scenes.heading: ALIBABA OPEN-SOURCED ITS *CODE REVIEWER*
scenes.say: Alibaba built an AI code reviewer for its own engineers, ran it internally for two years, and just open sourced it. It is called {Open Code Review|Open Code Review}.
Forty six thousand stars in about five months, Apache licensed, and it reads real Git diffs.

scenes.heading: THEIR *BENCHMARK*: 1/9 THE TOKENS
scenes.say: On their own benchmark of two hundred real pull requests, it reports higher precision than Claude Code, using about a ninth of the tokens. Lower recall is the trade they chose.

scenes.heading: HOW IT *WORKS*
steps: Picks exactly which files to review
Bundles related files into one unit
Rules plus an agent, then line-level comments
scenes.say: Instead of asking a chat model to read everything, it decides which files to review, bundles related files together, matches review rules, and only then lets the agent write precise comments.

scenes.title: CLI
scenes.heading: SETUP: *TWO* STEPS
scenes.say: Setup is an npm install, then ocr review in your repository. You pick any model provider you already pay for.

scenes.heading: THE *CATCH*
cons: Recall is lower than general agents, by design
You configure an LLM endpoint or use delegation
pros: Plugins for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Kimi Code
Delegation mode needs no extra API key
scenes.say: The catches: recall is lower than a general agent, by design; you need to configure an endpoint unless you use delegation; and it wants Git two point four one or newer. It is Apache licensed with an OpenSSF Gold badge, plugins exist for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Kimi Code, and delegation mode needs no extra API key.
Would you let AI review your pull requests? Comment Review and I will pin the repo.

youtube.description:
Open Code Review is Alibaba's internal AI code-review assistant, open sourced in May 2026 under Apache-2.0: it reads git diffs, picks and bundles files deterministically, then uses an LLM agent for line-level comments. The project's own AACR-Bench (200 real PRs, 1,505 ground-truth issues) reports higher precision and F1 than Claude Code at about 1/9 the tokens, with deliberately lower recall. Install: npm install -g @alibaba-group/open-code-review; Git 2.41+. 46,341 stars as of 12 October 2026.
Source: https://github.com/alibaba/open-code-review
